title: The tax criteria version, the remittance channel of R-WO-51, the home of the remittance record and the scan trigger have no owner, table or contract in rwb-writeoff
source: Legacy RWB-E6-014 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E6-014); FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.2, A2.1.3.1, A2.15.3.1 and Requirements served; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T4, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-01, R-WO-03, R-WO-04 and R-WO-51; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 feature row FEAT-WOF-02 and FEAT-WOF-14; Context pack S7 (service row, ownership rows, connection matrix row S7); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-09, DP-10 and R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow steps 1 to 8; 5 Exception paths X4 to X6; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC3; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.2; 12.4; 12.6; 13 Solution plan; 19 Out of scope
description: One combined row for the tax-criteria slice of RWB-E6-014. (1) No source gives the tax criteria a home: VR-S7-002-1 and R-WO-03 test tax_criteria_version and hold the scan at SCAN_HELD when it is absent, FEAT-WOF-14 lets the centre of excellence publish the criteria as a versioned rule load, and the R-WO-03 systems column reads 'Reference data, Finance provision feed', yet no table, no reference-data set, no parameter key and no owner is named. (2) No source gives the R-WO-51 trigger a channel: the condition is 'the buyer confirms receipt', while the connection matrix row S7 carries no event line from S6 debtsale or S9 partner, and the buyer is met on the partner portal. (3) write_off has no field for a remittance reference, a sold-lot reference or a buyer reference: TSD S7 T3.1 gives DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with recovered_after as the only post charge off amount. (4) The step's trigger is job JOB-16 in the context pack and a Temporal Schedule in the Temporal and Drools Design, while DP-10 and its RWB-PLT-E1071-CON row are absent from the key's pattern set and H row. (5) DP-04 and DP-09 are absent although the step evaluates a 51-rule package and the service owns topic EV-24 with event WriteOffApproved. (6) The plan's C row is None while the step needs the rwb-case population read and case-move answer and the rwb-decision package read, and no source publishes an operation name for any of the three.
evidence: FSD S7 v3 A2.2.3.1 (VR-S7-002-1 and R-WO-01, R-WO-03, R-WO-51 with BR-S7-002); TSD S7 v2 T3.1 (DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020, recovered_after and tax_criteria_met only), T4 (R-WO-01, R-WO-03, R-WO-04, R-WO-51 over 51 rules and 27 states), T5.3 ('WriteOffApproved | Published'), T6.1 (rights on Write-off and posting) and T-A.1 (API-S7-001, API-S7-002 only); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-01, R-WO-03 and R-WO-51; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 ('FEAT-WOF-02 ... Runs unattended | Workbench | FEAT-WOF-01', 'FEAT-WOF-14 ... versioned rule load'); context pack S7 (table write_off, events EV-24, jobs JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow, connection matrix row S7 with no S6, S9 or P8 event source for a buyer remittance); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-09, DP-10
area: Contract and data: tax criteria version, R-WO-51 trigger channel, remittance record, scan trigger, absent DP-04, DP-09 and DP-10 rows, absent C rows
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-writeoff with the P7 owner of the rule package and the Finance owner of the tax criteria
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S7-002-1 to ASM-B2-S7-002-6 in RWB-S7-E6014-CON and apply it to RWB-S7-E6014-APP: tax_criteria_version is a package fact of rwb-decision read with its version and recorded with the outcome; the tax-criteria result is write_off.tax_criteria_met and the post charge off remittance is write_off.recovered_after with no new table or column; the R-WO-51 confirmation reaches the step as a signal the parent CaseWorkflow forwards and no subscription is declared; the monthly scan Schedule from JOB-16 belongs to RWB-S7-E6013-APP and the DP-10, DP-04 and DP-09 rows are recorded as absent rather than added; the three consumed rows are declared as class C rows on the baseline and faked. Confirm with the P7 owner of the rule package and the Finance owner of the tax criteria at the wave 4 contract freeze.

title: The scan element, its required set, the tax-criteria result shape and the remittance element have no published field list
source: TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3 and T-A.1, T-A.2; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.2 and A2.15; legacy RWB-E6-014 sections 7, 11 and 19; Context pack S7; Template and Rules v1 R3, R5.5 DP-09, DP-13 and DP-14, R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC7; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.1 to 12.9; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the contract of the tax-criteria step. (1) TSD S7 T-A.2 names API-S7-001 with a ScanRequest request and a WriteOffScan response and gives no field list for either, so the properties and the required set of both elements are published by this baseline as a working read. (2) No source states how the tax-criteria result and its version are carried in the answer: write_off.tax_criteria_met is a boolean with no version column, and tax_criteria_version has no home, so the version is carried as a package fact beside the boolean. (3) No source publishes a remittance element: R-WO-51 records the remittance against the sold account and the only candidate field is recovered_after, with no reference, no buyer and no lot field. (4) No source lists the body of EV-24, and this baseline declares no event of the step, so the absence is asserted instead. (5) No source states the idempotency of the scan beyond the Idempotency-Key header of TSD S7 T-A.2.
evidence: TSD S7 v2 T-A.1 (API-S7-001 POST /api/recovery/v1/write-off-scans, API-S7-002 POST /api/recovery/v1/write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision) and T-A.2 (Purpose, Request ScanRequest, Response WriteOffScan, Errors 401, 403, 409, 422, 503, Idempotency-Key header, no field list) and T3.1 (DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020) and T3.2 (empty list table) and T5.3 ('WriteOffApproved | Published'); legacy RWB-E6-014 section 7 AC1 to AC4 and section 11 (recovery_case, decision_log_entry, rule_row); Template and Rules v1 R3 item 1 above item 6, R5.5 DP-09, DP-13 and DP-14, R7.2 s12
area: Contract: scan element, required set, tax-criteria result shape, remittance element, event body
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-writeoff tech lead and the P3 and P7 owners
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S7-002-1 to ASM-B2-S7-002-6 in RWB-S7-E6014-CON: POST /write-off-scans on base /api/recovery/writeoff/v1 with a ScanRequest and a WriteOffScan of status 201, the eleven write-off properties of DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with id, case_id, amount, tax_criteria_met and recovered_after required, the tax criteria version carried as a package fact beside the result, the remittance as an update of recovered_after and not a new element family, the Idempotency-Key on the POST and no event and no Schedule of the step. The baseline tags itself and the app story builds against it on Day 1. Confirm with the solution architect, the P3 owner of the case and the P7 owner of the rule package at the wave 4 contract freeze.
